policy: Independent shared artist/legal/P-T fits selected only on calibration printings. Full artist credit and brush measured here, beyond the rightmost 95px fitting crop. Actual full painter, frozen scan-only poses, no per-card layout changes. All pixels outside the footer region remain unchanged on all 81 cards.
metric: Expected-ink-polarity dark edge F1 and Census: higher is better; symmetric mean edge distance: lower is better. These are component measurements, not whole-card accuracy.
